sherry-shaw.text: Shaw, retired Walnut Valley Water District general manager, said her short-term priorities are working with staff on budgets and rate adjustments and giving quarterly City Council presentations on cost-saving programs such as free irrigation leak repairs and conservation.

source.title: Claremont Courier: Election 2026 profiles: Three Valleys Municipal Water Board (Sept. 10, 2026)

sherry-shaw.text: On rate stability, Shaw cited Metropolitan Water District's shift toward higher fixed charges and declining usage revenue, and said reducing the number of Equivalent Dwelling Units assigned to Claremont and La Verne "warrants further discussion."

source.title: Claremont Courier: Election 2026 profiles: Three Valleys Municipal Water Board (Sept. 10, 2026)

sherry-shaw.text: Lists infrastructure replacement, developing future leaders and Three Valleys' response to invasive golden mussels as mid- to long-term priorities.

source.title: Claremont Courier: Election 2026 profiles: Three Valleys Municipal Water Board (Sept. 10, 2026)

sherry-shaw.text: Said she sought appointment to the vacant seat so Claremont and La Verne would not "go unrepresented until December," but the board "ultimately chose not to appoint someone."

source.title: Claremont Courier: Election 2026 profiles: Three Valleys Municipal Water Board (Sept. 10, 2026)

jeff-hanlon.text: Hanlon, who held the seat from 2022 until resigning in June 2026, said "fully realizing the groundwater storage potential in our region is my top priority" for resilience to "drought and climate change."

source.title: Claremont Courier: Election 2026 profiles: Three Valleys Municipal Water Board (Sept. 10, 2026)

jeff-hanlon.text: "We must also safeguard against excessive rate increases." Said the budget he "helped pass in May actually reduced the rates at which Three Valleys sells water to retailers while continuing to build needed budget reserves."

source.title: Claremont Courier: Election 2026 profiles: Three Valleys Municipal Water Board (Sept. 10, 2026)

jeff-hanlon.text: Pledges to keep "pressuring Metropolitan Water District's Board of Directors to approve and fund the full scope of the Pure Water Southern California water recycling program," calling it a "needed climate-proof project."

source.title: Claremont Courier: Election 2026 profiles: Three Valleys Municipal Water Board (Sept. 10, 2026)

jeff-hanlon.text: Said groundwater purchase-and-storage and pump-back investments "may be prudent, given our need to reduce overall system reliance on the Colorado River imported water," weighed against budget considerations.

source.title: Claremont Courier: Election 2026 profiles: Three Valleys Municipal Water Board (Sept. 10, 2026)

notes: Vacant seat (Hanlon resigned in June 2026 to apply for a staff job he didn't get; the board declined to appoint anyone). Monica Aleman Gibbs declined the Claremont Courier's interview; no other statements found for her. Hanlon says four current board members endorse him (not recorded as an item). Searches used: 6
